description: CYBERGUARD model calibration. email_model_version selects which email phishing artifacts app/services/ml_inference.py serves: v1 = email_tfidf.pkl + email_phishing_xgb.pkl (word TF-IDF, English-only), v2 = email_tfidf_v2.pkl + email_phishing_xgb_v2.pkl (char n-gram 2-4 TF-IDF + XGBoost, multilingual en/hi/te/or/romanised). deepfake_model_version selects the single neural deepfake artifact deepfake_cnn_<version>.pt (currently v2: MobileNetV3-Small 128px on GenImage, messenger-robust). There is exactly one neural deepfake artifact — the old 32x32 v1 CNN was deleted; if the selected file is missing the detector degrades to heuristics-only (ELA splice + metadata) with an explicit 'heuristics-only-fallback' ml_model indicator and a logged warning. If the calibrated email artifacts are missing the email loader falls back to v1 with a logged warning.
